versions.changelog:
tech-report-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release supporting automatic generation of HTML technical reports from patent Excel data.
- Enables full workflow: keyword tagging, data analysis (industry trends, key companies, technology categories), and interactive HTML report creation.
- Customizable via user-edited Python config files for keywords, company highlights, and news content.
- Retains Excel metadata including hyperlinks and patent images; output integrates clickable links and embedded images.
- Command-line interface for quick start, with guided parameter and config setup.
